trial_court: Family Court, Imphal East, Matrimonial (Divorce) Suit No. 27 of 2021
case_name: Smt. Yumkhaibam Gaitri Devi vs Hanglem Ghonideepak
facts_of_case: Matrimonial divorce suit filed by husband seeking dissolution of marriage was decreed on 09.10.2025. Wife is on appeal and permanent alimony has been granted.

legal_principles.principle: A delay of 24 days in filing a statutory appeal under Section 19 of the Family Courts Act, 1984 is not condonable.
legal_principles.held: In the hearing today, Mr. Anjan Prasad Sahu, learned counsel on record for MC applicant and Ms. Lekhakumari, learned counsel for sole respondent in MC (to be noted, Ms. Lekhakumari has since filed Vakalatnama for the sole respondent) are before this Court.

legal_principles.principle: A matrimonial divorce suit being a suit filed by the husband seeking dissolution of marriage was decreed after full contest.
legal_principles.held: Matrimonial (Divorce) Suit No. 27 of 2021 on the file of Family Court, Imphal East being a suit filed by the husband seeking dissolution of marriage was decreed (after full contest) on 09.10.2025 vide the impugned judgment.
cited_cases: Smt. Yumkhaibam Gaitri Devi vs Hanglem Ghonideepak, (2026) X SCC Y

outcome.final_order: Delay condoned, captioned MC ordered as prayed for. No order as to costs.

use_for_drafting: condoning delays in family court appeals
advising on Hindu Marriage Act provisions
